"bbbbb" → 1
"abba" → 2

[] → []
[[1,4],[2,3]] → [[1,4]]

[], 0 → 0

[2], 3 → -1
[2,5], 0 → 0
Explain why greedy is not always correct.

[] → []

{a:[b], b:[a]} → null
{} → []

[], [2] → [2]
[], [] → []

[7,6,4,3,1] → 0
[] → 0
Assume representable integer arithmetic.
